answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a grove as the anchor of the cost.
